info.description: Public resident schedules and cookie-authenticated transit administration. Mutations require an administrator session, a trusted Origin, and X-CSRF-Token from login or /auth/me.
info.title: Public Transport Service API

post.summary: Sign in and establish an opaque cookie session

post.description: Requires a trusted Origin. Expired or missing sessions are cleared idempotently.
post.summary: Invalidate the local session and clear its cookie

get.description: Accepts origin (origin_stop_id and/or origin) and destination (destination_stop_id and/or destination). Returns direct, multi-transfer (up to 3 transfers), and walking-connected itinerary options with ordered leg stops, optional live estimates, and exclusion of cancelled trips, closed stops, and disrupted route segments, or a meaningful message when no itinerary is found.
get.summary: Search transit journeys between two locations

parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp; defaults to from plus 6 hours
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: Maximum straight-line walking distance per walk leg in meters (0 disables walking)
parameters.name: max_walk_meters

get.summary: List all routes, including inactive routes

post.description: Requires an administrator session cookie, trusted Origin, and the CSRF token from login or /auth/me.

delete.description: Requires an administrator session cookie, trusted Origin, and the CSRF token from login or /auth/me.
delete.summary: Deactivate a route while preserving related records

patch.description: Requires an administrator session cookie, trusted Origin, and the CSRF token from login or /auth/me.

get.summary: Get route polyline geometry for map rendering
List active vehicles for a route

get.description: Filters combine with AND. Path IDs fix their filter; conflicting query IDs are rejected. Departure windows are [from, until), at most 24 hours. /api/departures requires at least one ID filter.
get.summary: Get stop details and upcoming departures

parameters.description: RFC3339 timestamp; defaults to from plus 2 hours
parameters.name: until

get.description: Returns estimated arrival times for active vehicles on routes serving the requested stop (optionally filtered by route_id) that have recent location data. Returns an empty array when no active vehicle with recent location data is approaching the stop.
get.summary: Get estimated bus arrivals at a stop

get.description: Returns estimated arrival times for upcoming stops of an active trip that has recent vehicle location data, preserving scheduled arrival times. Returns an empty array when no active vehicle with recent location data is reporting on the trip.
get.summary: Get estimated bus arrivals for a trip
List active vehicles for a trip

get.description: Filters active non-retired vehicles reported within max_age_seconds (default 900s) by optional route_id, route_number, or trip_id.

post.description: Requires an administrator session cookie, trusted Origin, and X-CSRF-Token. Updates the vehicle's latest GPS coordinates, speed, heading, route/trip assignment, and operating status.
